summary: Frontend E2E for new Balanço/Património (balance-sheet) section on Finanças > Perfil Financeiro. All new UI, data-testids, editor prefill, save flow, breakdown listing, and CEO analysis integration work correctly. Math verified end-to-end (Total ativos = caixa + assets, Total passivos = total_debt + liabilities, Património líquido = ativos - passivos).
action_items: TEST-ENV: The admin profile was NOT reset to empty as stated in the review request. When navigating to /financas the profile-view was already rendered (empty state did not appear). Pre-existing data included an asset 'Stock €10 000' and a liability 'Impostos €15 500'. Because of this, when the tester added the specified assets (Carrinhas 40000, Ferramentas 15000) and liability (Impostos 15500), the pre-existing Stock/Impostos remained in the profile, so final totals were 68 000 / 61 000 / 7 000 instead of the requested 58 000 / 45 500 / 12 500. Math is correct given the actual data. If main agent wants a clean run matching the review numbers, hard-reset the admin profile in Mongo (finance profile doc for adminceoai@gmail.com) before re-testing.

MINOR UX: Because openEditor keeps existing assets/liabilities and the empty state check is (assets>0 || liabilities>0), it's easy for a user to end up with duplicated entries (e.g., two 'Impostos €15 500' rows visible in Passivos breakdown after this test). Consider de-duping in UI or making it obvious the existing rows are preserved when re-editing.
critical_code_review_comments: Finances.jsx openEditor: assets/liabilities default to [] when empty, but fixed_costs defaults to [{name:'',amount:''}] — inconsistent UX; consider same pattern for all three so the user sees at least one empty row for guidance.

Balance-sheet section only renders when total_assets>0 || total_liabilities>0; if user only has cash_balance (which counts as an asset via total_assets in backend), it should still render — verify backend total_assets includes cash so condition works for cash-only case.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for balance-sheet feature (verified against real persisted data)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin profile which had pre-existing assets/liabilities (Stock €10 000, Impostos €15 500).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Balance-sheet UI (data-testid=balance-sheet) shows three metric tiles (Total de ativos, Total de passivos, Património líquido) and a two-column breakdown (Ativos: Caixa + assets[], Passivos: Dívida/financiamentos + liabilities[]). Editor uses add-asset-btn / asset-name-{i} / asset-amount-{i} / asset-remove-{i} and same for liability-*. Edit prefill confirmed. CEO analysis endpoint responded in ~10s and correctly referenced the negative net position of 27.000 EUR.
rca of the issue: Not a bug — expected numbers in the review request assumed a clean/empty admin profile which wasn't the case at test time. Feature itself is functioning correctly.
